m86bz5a4.baseName: Christmas Tree World 7ft Slim Gold Tinsel Pop-Up Christmas Tree
m86bz5a4.variantName: Christmas Tree World 7ft Slim Gold Tinsel Pop-Up Christmas Tree
m86bz5a4.sourceDescription: The ideal hybrid between traditional tinsel decorations, slim Xmas trees, and convenient pop-up function, the 7ft Slim Gold Tinsel Pop-Up Tree adds a touch of glamour to any festive space. Perfect for those with limited time on their hands, these affordable Christmas trees are sure to dazzle guests while saving you precious hours of assembly. Simply take your tree out of the box and that's all there is to it no need for branch fluffing or adding Christmas tree decorations, it's all done for you! Best of all, as they are slimline, they can fit pretty much anywhere, no matter your square footage! Picture shows 6ft tree in the tree. Product Features • Size: 7ft • Tinsel suspended garland • Tree Width: 55cm diameter • Tinsel colour: Gold • Space Saving: Unique pop-up design • Easy assembly: Garland suspends around centrepole • Sturdy base: Plastic feet • Indoor use only: The trees construction will rust in rain • Height measured from the floor • Eligible for European shipping • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World, Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate, Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester, WN5 8DB, United Kingdom

sxrkaa19.variantName: Scottish Everlastings Artificial Green Foliage Half Wreath - 40cm
sxrkaa19.sourceDescription: Refresh your décor with the modern simplicity of this 40cm artificial green foliage half wreath, a sleek, understated piece that proves less really is more. Featuring a graceful arc of lush, lifelike greenery arranged on a minimalist open frame, this half wreath brings a clean, contemporary touch to any space. Perfect for year round display, seasonal styling, or even as a statement piece for weddings and events, it's a beautiful way to add natural texture without the fuss. Hang it on doors, walls, or windows for an effortlessly elegant look. Whether your vibe is modern farmhouse, boho chic, or classic minimalism, this half wreath brings a touch of the outdoors in, stylishly and effortlessly. Wreath width: D40cm. Bring indoors during adverse weather conditions. Materials: Plastic and fabric. Bring indoors in adverse weather conditions SEL UK Ltd Frances Industrial Park, Wemyss Road, Kirkcaldy KY12XZ
